name: Simetría Facial en Video
description: Analiza la simetría facial en video para detectar deepfakes
algorithm: Facial Symmetry (Video) — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial symmetry patterns in video for deepfake detection:

1. **Bilateral Feature Medición**: Corresponding bilateral facial features are measured: left/right eye size, eyebrow position, cheek contour, nasolabial fold depth, lip corner position. The asymmetry (difference between left and right) is quantified for each feature pair.

2. **Natural Asymmetry Baseline**: All human faces exhibit natural bilateral asymmetry — typically 2-5% difference between sides. The method establishes per-subject asymmetry characteristics and checks whether they fall within normal ranges. Deepfakes may produce unnaturally symmetric faces (≈0% asymmetry) or exaggerated asymmetry inconsistent with natural variation.

3. **Pose - Adjusted Simetría**: Apparent symmetry changes with head pose due to perspective projection. The method compensates for head pose to measure intrinsic facial symmetry. After correction, true facial asymmetry should remain constant regardless of viewing angle. Deepfakes may show pose-dependent symmetry changes indicating inconsistent 3D face modeling.

4. **Dynamic Simetría Análisis**: During expressions, bilateral symmetry changes predictably — genuine smiles may be slightly asymmetric, surprise is relatively symmetric. The method analyzes dynamic symmetry patterns during expression events. Deepfakes may produce symmetric expressions when natural ones should be asymmetric, or vice versa.

5. **Temporal Simetría Estabilidad**: The subject's baseline facial asymmetry should remain constant across the video (bone structure doesn't change). The method tracks symmetry metrics temporally. Frame-to-frame variations in facial asymmetry — caused by independent generation of left and right face halves — indicate AI generation artifacts.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante facial symmetry (video) analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
